title: Mortal Kombat II
overview:
You've never experienced this level of Kombat! It's the ultimate arcade translation you've been waiting for! All the hidden arcade secrets! Eye-popping straight-from-the-arcade graphics! Pulse-pounding music and sound F/X! From "Finish Him" to "Flawless Victory," nothing, nothing can prepare you for the most spectacular Kombat of them all!

After failing to stop Liu Kang, the sorcerer Shang Tsung convinces his master Shao Kahn, ruler of Outworld, to hold the next Mortal Kombat tournament in his own realm. Rayden gathers Earth's warriors and leads them into Outworld. Pick from 12 fighters, including newcomers Kung Lao, Jax, Kitana, Mileena and Baraka, defeat the other warriors, then take on Shang Tsung, Kintaro and finally Shao Kahn. When an opponent is left dazed, finish the job with a Fatality, a stage Fatality, a Babality or a Friendship.

- 1 or 2 players, with a second player able to jump in mid-game
- All 12 Kombat warriors
- Five difficulty settings
